headline: WARSH PIVOTS AT ECB SINTRA: GOLD SURGES 2% TO $4,090 — IRAN TENSIONS ADD FUEL AS FED RATE-HIKE FEARS EASE
snippet: Gold spot surged from morning lows near $4,030 to a session high of $4,115 on July 1 after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh acknowledged at the ECB's Sintra forum that inflation risks have eased and signalled he is abandoning traditional forward guidance — a comment markets read as a shift away from September rate-hike expectations that had crushed gold for 11 consecutive weeks. US-Iran tensions over stalled Qatar talks simultaneously stoked safe-haven demand, lifting gold back above $4,090 in its strongest afternoon session since February 2026, while the VanEck Gold Miners ETF bounced from its 200-day moving average support and silver snapped a seven-session losing streak.

headline: CATL RESTARTS JIANXIAWO LITHIUM MINE — 100,000-TONNE/YR CAPACITY BACK ONLINE, ~3% OF GLOBAL LITHIUM SUPPLY RETURNS
snippet: CATL's suspended Jianxiawo lithium mine in Jiangxi Province received its safety production permit on June 29, 2026 and resumed operations the same evening, returning approximately 100,000 tonnes per year of hard-rock lithium capacity — roughly 46,000 tonnes of lithium carbonate equivalent annually, or around 3% of global supply — to a market that had already priced in a restart with a near-10% price drop over the two prior trading sessions. Analysts caution the mine's return is bearish for spot prices through H2 2026, but note that substantial new battery cell manufacturing capacity entering service in Q3 may absorb a portion of the incremental tonnes, while the GFEX yuan lithium futures market opened to overseas traders July 3 adds a new price-discovery dynamic.

headline: U.S. FIRST IN HISTORY TO ACHIEVE CRITICALITY IN 3 UNIQUE ADVANCED MICROREACTOR DESIGNS IN ONE MONTH — TRUMP NUCLEAR GOAL MET
snippet: Deployable Energy's Unity compact nuclear reactor achieved initial criticality at Idaho National Laboratory on July 1, 2026 — the third unique advanced microreactor design to go critical under President Trump's America 250 initiative, fulfilling his goal before the July 4 bicentennial deadline. The milestone follows Antares Nuclear (June 4) and Valar Atomics (June 18) and makes the U.S. the first country in history to achieve criticality in three distinct advanced reactor designs within a single calendar month, accelerating near-term demand for low-enriched uranium fuel and reinforcing the investment bull case for uranium producers ahead of utility term contracting analysts expect to accelerate in H2 2026.

headline: 70M AT 2.9 g/t AU LINKS HURRICANE ZONES, 400M DOWN-PLUNGE OPENS: BENZ MINING EXPANDS GLENBURGH CAMP, WA (TSXV:BZ)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Benz Mining Corp.
snippet: Benz Mining Corp. (TSXV:BZ) released June 29, 2026 drill results showing Hurricane Camp at the Glenburgh Gold Project in Western Australia is growing on all fronts: Zone 126 and Zone 102 are now physically linked for the first time (shallow high-grade gold confirmed between them), and first-pass holes drilled more than 400 metres down-plunge of Zone 126 have intersected the mineralised system — potentially doubling the Hurricane search space. Headline intervals include 70 metres at 2.9 g/t gold from 214 metres (including 37 metres at 5.2 g/t), 56 metres at 1.6 g/t from 162 metres, and 49 metres at 1.7 g/t from 336 metres.

headline: 32.8M AT 1.22 g/t AU FROM 166M: GOLD X2 DRILLING HITS NEAR-SURFACE SHEARS AT 6.67M-OZ ONTARIO DEPOSIT (TSXV:AUXX)
source_name: Resource World / Gold X2 Mining Inc.
snippet: Gold X2 Mining Inc. (TSXV:AUXX) released June 30, 2026 infill drill results from the Moss Gold Project in Northwest Ontario, with winter ice-drilling on Snodgrass Lake returning 32.8 metres at 1.22 g/t gold from 166.2 metres — confirming near-surface expansion potential at the shallow margin of the Main Zone within a 6.67-million-ounce deposit (2.46 Moz Indicated at 1.04 g/t Au, 4.21 Moz Inferred at 0.97 g/t Au). All six holes of the season drilled on the southern zone margin intersected gold-bearing shear zones; an updated NI 43-101 resource estimate is expected Q4 2026 or Q1 2027.

headline: NEW HOPE COPPER PORPHYRY FAR BIGGER THAN DRILLED: ALMADEX EXTENDS IP ANOMALY 1.95KM EAST IN ARIZONA (TSX-V:DEX)
snippet: Almadex Minerals Ltd. (TSX-V:DEX) released June 30, 2026 results from the second hole of its first-pass drill program at the New Hope copper-gold porphyry target in Arizona: mineralisation was limited (6 metres at 0.15% copper in late diorite intrusives), but induced polarisation geophysics has extended the porphyry anomaly 1.95 kilometres east of the two holes drilled, revealing a 2.5 × 0.75-kilometre IP chargeability anomaly that completely dwarfs the tested margin. Stage II drilling is being planned to test the core of the larger system in a state where domestic copper sourcing is a declared U.S. national security priority.

headline: GOLD SEEKER ISSUE #72: MINERS WERE "AWAITING A CATALYST" — THE FED CHAIR'S SINTRA PIVOT JUST DELIVERED IT
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly Gold Seeker newsletter (Issue #72) framed gold, silver, and mining stocks as collectively "awaiting a catalyst" — a label that proved prescient within 24 hours as Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's softened tone at the ECB's Sintra forum on July 1 delivered precisely the macro signal precious metals investors had been looking for. The newsletter reviewed key technical levels across the sector, noting deteriorating sentiment, multi-week oversold conditions, and compressed valuations relative to the gold price as conditions historically associated with sharp recoveries once a directional catalyst arrives.
